name: @neverland-money/address-book
description: Address book for Neverland Lending protocol contract addresses
author: Neverland Team

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); for (const name of fs.readdirSync('.')) if (name === 'dist' || name.includes('.log')) fs.rmSync(name, { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.check-types: cd ../.. && node ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/address-book/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/address-book/tsconfig.json --module commonjs --noEmit
scripts.build: yarn clean && cd ../.. && node ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/address-book/tsconfig.json && node ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/address-book/tsconfig.json --module commonjs --outDir ./packages/address-book/dist/cjs
